row.notes: Copies rivalry type (email+0xf0 -> vm+0x408) and email type (email+0xf1 -> vm+0x409), sets title strings at +0x48/+0x88/+0x68, caches the career object (+0x308), k_Career_RivalManagerComponentDesc (+0x310) and the contracts manager (+0x318), copies the entrant list and finds the player. For rivalry types 0-2 it finds the player's driver rivalry in rival manager +0xbd8, for type 3 the team rivalry in +0xbf8; it stores the intensity level (+0x40a), both overall ratings (+0x40c/+0x410), the player and rival refs (+0xc8/+0xe8), two score values (+0x110/+0x130), the difference (+0x150) with its description (+0x168/+0x170, flag +0x190) and a thumbnail request. It then writes reward data from the per-type table (rival manager +0x810/+0x6c8/+0x2a8/+0x928, 0x48 stride by intensity) to +0xa8/+0x270/+0x290/+0x2b0, intensity text and texture (+0x1c8/+0x1e8/+0x210) and, for email type 2 or 3, the "#overrides.career.laptop.rivalry_email_close_proximity_bg.win" or ".loss" texture at +0x230 with flag +0x250. Caller Vm_CareerEmail_BindTemplates runs it for template case 0xc after binding the rivalry nodes; good hook to change what rivalry emails show. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
